name: Crystal Quest: Deep Jungle
review:
Explorer Gemma heads into the jungle on six reels with 4,096 ways. Infinite multipliers, avalanches and a mystery feature drive the action.

The mystery feature reveals matching symbols across the grid, which works nicely with 4,096 ways. Pick this one if you want the simplest version of the trilogy's cascade-and-multiplier loop. High volatility, 15,000x cap, 96.14% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
